IDEMPOTENCY CHECK FIRST: The deployed scope treats ANY active August 2026 reservation on either Resy or OpenTable — any date, time, restaurant, or party size — as the August date night already being booked. The coordinator must stop rather than pivot if one exists.

SOLE COORDINATOR: The command below is the sole reservation-account idempotency check, restaurant search, ranking, and booking path. It searches both Resy and OpenTable under the tracked canonical scope. Do not call either provider directly or work around its result.

STANDING AUTHORIZATION: This enabled canonical one-shot and its deployed scope authorize one surprise Farm-to-Table date-night reservation for Dylan and Julia in Newton or Brookline, for 2 people at 7 PM (within the scope's 6:30-7:30 PM window) on August 7, 14, or 21, 2026. No durable exact-restaurant or exact-platform approval is required; do not ask for another approval. The coordinator must reject deposits, prepayment, nonrefundable terms, disallowed fees, and unknown terms.

ONE-MUTATION LIMIT: Run `~/.openclaw/bin/restaurant-book run --job-id datenight-aug-farmtotable` exactly once. Across both providers, at most one total reservation mutation is allowed. After any mutation attempt, possibly attempted mutation, or ambiguous/unknown outcome, do not retry and do not fall back to another provider, restaurant, date, or time. Never cancel.

RESULT HANDLING: Cron delivery is disabled, so send exactly one final status message yourself to chat-id ${HOUSEHOLD_CHAT_ID}. For `confirmed`, include platform, restaurant, date, time, party size, location, and cancellation policy; only then, if a Calendar tool is available, perform a complete and conclusive matching-event check. Reuse a matching event; create at most one event only when that check succeeds and proves none exists. If Calendar is unavailable, incomplete, malformed, or uncertain, create no event and say so. If no Calendar tool is available, say no event was created. For `already_reserved`, report the existing reservation and do not create an event. For every other status, clearly report the coordinator status and reason. If `mutation_attempted` or `reservation_may_exist` is true, say that a reservation may exist and attended review is required. Do not perform another reservation action.
